title: Republic of Korea MFA — entry requirements and visa / K-ETA notice for foreigners
publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Korea (Korean embassy to Singapore)
claims: Foreigners entering Korea must hold either a K-ETA or a visa; the passport only needs to remain valid throughout the stay, with no minimum remainder-validity rule.

K-ETA is applied for at www.k-eta.go.kr; nationals not eligible for K-ETA apply through the Korea Visa Application Centre; some nationalities and age groups are exempt, and K-ETA exemption for listed countries is extended until 31 December 2026.
An e-Arrival card must be submitted within three days before arrival; no vaccination requirement and no COVID-19 test are required.
